item.title: Law, Technology and Humans
item.description: Law, Technology and Humans provides an inclusive and unique forum for exploration of the broader connections, history and emergent future of law and technology through supporting research that takes seriously the human, and humanity of law and technology. ISSN: 2652-4074 (Online)
